check1_nvd.source: NVD CVE API 2.0, raw JSON cached in verification/range_checks/cache/nvd/
check1_nvd.matching_heuristic: vulnerable=true CPE matches with part "a" (non-negated nodes); product matched to the npm name after lower-casing and removing non-alphanumerics: "exact" = product equals the package name (or scope+name for scoped packages); "affix" = equal after stripping a leading "node" and trailing "js" (min. 3 chars); otherwise (ambiguous, reported separately) "fallback_name_overlap" = exactly one application product whose compact name contains or is contained in the package name (>= 4 chars, e.g. lodash-es -> lodash), else "fallback_single_product" = the CVE lists exactly one application product; among matched entries only target_sw in {node.js, nodejs, node, npm, *, -} are kept; entries with version "-" and no bounds are unusable. NVD bounds are compared with npm semver ordering (non-semver bounds coerced, flagged). An advisory with several usable entries is "affected" if any entry covers used_version.
check1_nvd.agreement_note: rows are clustered (the same package/version/advisory appears in many projects); Wilson intervals treat rows as independent, so the unique (package, used_version, advisory) triples are the more honest denominator

advisory_version_sets.method: all published non-prerelease npm versions of the package (cache/npm) evaluated against the GHSA range(s) of that advisory and the selected NVD entries

unbounded_vs_nvd.unit: unique (advisory, package, used_version) of positives with usable primary NVD entries; NVD entries that cover used_version are inspected

check2_unbounded.definition: A matched advisory is "bounded" for an instance if a comparator set of its GHSA range that covers used_version has a >=, > or exact lower bound > 0.0.0 (node semver Range parse, commas -> spaces as in src/semver_batch.cjs); otherwise "unbounded below" (e.g. "< 4.17.21", "<= x", ">= 0.0.0, < y", "> 0.0.0"). An instance is "unbounded-only" if ALL its matched advisories are unbounded. Secondary rule "effectively unbounded": also counts a bounded range whose lower bound is <= the lowest non-prerelease version ever published for the package (npm cache).

check2_backtests.protocol: executed_source.py fixed parameters, expanding window (train origins < test, window_end <= test origin), seed 42; package-cluster bootstrap 1,000 draws, default_rng(42) per origin, np.unique cluster order, draws without both classes skipped; recall10 = stable order top ceil(0.1n) as executed_source.py, recall10_expected = tie-aware expectation (relevant for the 0/1 libyear>1 rule)

check2_libyear.definition: Cohen d with pooled SD (ddof=1), instance level (every row) and unique package/version level, as thesis Table 5.10; libyear AUC = P(libyear_pos > libyear_neg) with ties 1/2
